Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class PigMotion.Step

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.PigMotion.Step
All Implemented Interfaces:

Enclosing class:

public static final class PigMotion.Step extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable result of a mechanical step; work is positive into the pig and friction heat is nonnegative.

  • Constructor Details

    • Step

      private Step(double duration, double position, double velocity, double displacement, double distance, double moving, double stop, double pressureWork, double gravityWork, double heat, double kineticChange)
      Creates and checks the complete step ledger.
      Parameters:
      duration - interval duration in s
      position - final position in m
      velocity - final velocity in m/s
      displacement - signed distance in m
      distance - total travelled distance in m
      moving - moving time in s
      stop - first moving-to-rest event time in s, or -1 if absent
      pressureWork - pressure work in J
      gravityWork - gravity work in J
      heat - dissipated friction energy in J
      kineticChange - kinetic energy change in J
